meta.name: ai-ab-testing
meta.description: A/B 测试设计助手适合市场营销、产品、运营、software在用户提出“这个改动值得测吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成转化问题优先级、可复制改稿、实验或跟进行动清单。

copy.tagline: 快速拆解A/B测试目标并生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需判断改动是否值得测试并快速产出实验方案
copy.tagline_en: Quickly break down A/B test goals and generate actionable plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to decide if a change is worth testing and quickly produce experiment plans

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析 A/B 测试需求，输出转化问题优先级、可复制改稿、实验或跟进行动清单。
howto.when: 当你提出“这个改动值得测吗”这类问题，或需要围绕转化目标、用户、页面材料生成可执行结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个注册页的 A/B 测试优先级。
say.note: Claude 会输出转化问题优先级和改稿建议。

say.text: 针对付费转化，设计一个实验方案。
say.note: Claude 会生成实验或跟进行动清单。

say.text: 评估这个改动是否值得做 A/B 测试。
say.note: Claude 会拆解目标并判断重点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you analyze A/B testing needs and outputs conversion issue priorities, copy variations, experiments, or action checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "Is this change worth testing?" or need actionable results around conversion goals, audience, or page materials.

say_en.text: Analyze the A/B test priorities for this landing page.
say_en.note: Claude outputs issue priorities and copy suggestions.

say_en.text: Design an experiment plan for paid conversion.
say_en.note: Claude generates experiment or action checklist.

say_en.text: Evaluate if this change is worth A/B testing.
say_en.note: Claude breaks down goals and identifies key points.
